sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Girl Explorer: Jigsaw Puzzles are centered around completing jigsaw puzzles. Players choose a scene to complete, select a difficulty level, and then begin placing puzzle pieces into the correct positions. The game features a variety of puzzle piece shapes and sizes, which can be rotated and rearranged to fit the correct spot. As players progress through the game, they'll encounter increasingly complex puzzles, requiring more strategy and problem-solving skills to complete.

One of the key features of Girl Explorer: Jigsaw Puzzles is its use of a 'fit' system, which helps players determine where puzzle pieces belong. The game also includes a 'hint' system, which provides players with subtle clues to help them solve difficult puzzles. Additionally, players can earn rewards and bonuses for completing puzzles quickly and efficiently, adding an extra layer of challenge and motivation to the game.

The game's controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for players to navigate the game world and complete puzzles.
